integrity: The proof combines a symbolic probability-generating-function identity and exhaustive finite canonical enumeration. The standalone program verifies all finite cases and separately checks a 65,536-configuration witness and third moments. Historical priority not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Rooted, unlabeled nonplane full-binary shapes, 2..16 leaves for exact first-collision census, all unit edges without a root stem; independent common leaf-extinction parameter. Collision means equality of full mean and variance polynomials, not equality at one parameter. Infinite extension is proved by grafting. General weighted and unrooted models and empirical ecological data are not addressed.
title: Sixteen taxa are sharp for moment-indistinguishable future phylogenetic-diversity laws
